shots.vo: The second survivor sits behind the glass. And he has *your face*.
The same scar on his palm. The same voice. He says: "I woke up today. And they told me *I* was the last."
Vera plays the footage from your home camera. 3:33. You're asleep in bed. And standing by the window… is *also you*.
The lights go out. Your double says your words *one second before* you do.
Vera whispers: the men didn't die. That night, the world *split in two*. They're over there. And you're *on the border*.
For the world to heal, one of you *has to leave*.
Your double presses his palm to the glass. You press yours. The glass turns *warm*.
Light floods the city. Lamps come on in the windows. *Thousands of men* wake up, and remember nothing.
And the morning news has one headline: last night, *one man disappeared* from Earth.
Would you *give yourself up* for everyone?
